title: Small Object Few-Shot Segmentation for Vision-Based Industrial Inspection (SOFS)
mechanism: FSS for small defects: no image resizing, prototype intensity downsampling of support masks, an abnormal prior map, and a mixed normal Dice loss that penalises false positives on defect-free supports.
evidence: R: outperforms FSS baselines on industrial small-defect benchmarks; also does few-shot anomaly detection.
adaptation: Run at native 512 px, episodic training on 478 cells by class, K-shot on half-cells; the mixed normal Dice idea can separately penalise crack false alarms on scuff streaks.
min_experiment: G0 entry for crack: SOFS K=16 vs house PF on H36/F51 crack relF1@2 and false-alarm rate on defect-free half-cells; kill if below house PF and no reduction of false alarms.
